TITLE: Mirror Coach
ACTIVITY: Applying makeup — ~90M US women, the majority daily; one of the highest-frequency female activities that exists.
CLAIM: A real-time corrective makeup coach: the VLM watches you actually apply product and gives live, specific feedback ("blend the contour up toward your ear," "that wing is asymmetric, lift the left 2mm," "you've over-applied blush, press a clean sponge here") — coaching technique on YOUR face mid-application, not previewing a filter.
NOVELTY: AR/scoring incumbents exist but a clear wedge remains. Found: Gloss AI (AR overlay outlines + voice prompts, pre-scripted placement, not corrective), FaceFlow (photo SCORING + canned tutorials), Beauty Coach (photo → TEXT steps), YouCam Makeup (300M users — virtual TRY-ON, not coaching application). None do closed-loop corrective feedback reacting to what you just did wrong. Crowded-ish; sharply differentiated wedge, not virgin space (flagged honestly).
USERBASE_SCORE: 10 — the largest, most frequent daily activity in the brief.
NOVELTY_SCORE: 6 — AR-overlay/scoring incumbents exist; the corrective-feedback mechanism is the open part.
MECHANISM: Live video → VLM comparing current face state to target look and previous frame, detecting application errors (symmetry, harsh edges, over-application, wrong placement for eye/face shape) and issuing targeted fixes. Newly possible: frame-to-frame VLM reasoning about subtle cosmetic differences now works. Cost bounded by keyframe sampling during active strokes only.
GROWTH_MONETIZATION: Before/after split-screens are inherently shareable (GRWM is the #1 beauty content genre). Freemium ~$8/mo pro for unlimited looks + occasion modes (wedding, interview). Brand-funded "master this look using X palette" placements. $1-5M at 30-50k subs; brand deals accelerate.
RISKS: (1) Gloss AI/YouCam/PerfectCorp best positioned to ship corrective coaching, could close wedge fast. (2) VLM precision on millimeter symmetry under bathroom lighting unproven. (3) Skill-mastery → users graduate and churn; needs trend-look refresh.
